name: rn-starter
description: Takes a clean machine to a running React Native app (rn-starter), analyzes tickets against the design and the API before building (rn-feature), turns a screen list, screenshots or a Figma design into themed, navigable screens (rn-ui), connects those screens from mocks to the real backend from its Swagger/OpenAPI spec (rn-api-connect), proves requirements with Maestro end-to-end flows (rn-e2e), sets up a dev app and the production app on EAS with store credentials (rn-release-setup), and runs production releases behind a merge-approved gate (rn-release).
